annotations.title: NY SLU % from range of motion

description: A schedule loss of use percentage range from measured range of motion, scored by the app's SLU range-of-motion engine (2018 NY Impairment Guidelines): each joint's deficit by severity band with proportional adjustment, the paired-motion rule (both_motions), the ankylosis cap for the body part, an optional special consideration (added or stand-alone, as the engine marks it), an optional contralateral baseline, and the shoulder muscle-atrophy finding. Joints per body part: Thumb IP/MCP/CMC (CMC is the opposition grade 1–3), Finger DIP/PIP/MCP, Wrist Palmar Flex/Dorsi Flex/Pron/Sup, Elbow Extension/Flexion, Shoulder Forward Flexion/Abduction/Int Rotation/Ext Rotation/Adduction/Post Extension, Hip Abduction/Adduction/Int Rotation/Ext Rotation/Flexion/Post Extension, Knee Flexion/Extension, Ankle/Foot Plantar Flex/Dorsi Flex/Inversion/Eversion, Great Toe IP/MTP Flex/MTP Ext, Smaller Toes DIP/PIP/MTP. Returns a percentage, not an award: pass the percentage to calculate_slu_award. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core, the same engine as the app and the Pro Workspace; it never estimates. A missing input returns status "missing" and nothing is calculated. Returns the figures, the steps with the rule and engine function behind each, and the not-legal-advice notice.

both_motions.description: Optional: joints whose paired motion (extension, supination) is also deficient, so the higher figure applies.

contralateral.description: Optional: joint name → the uninjured side's degrees, used as the baseline.

measurements.description: Joint name → measured degrees (Thumb CMC: opposition grade 1, 2 or 3). Joint names exactly as listed in the description.

shoulder_muscle_atrophy.description: Optional, shoulder: a muscle-atrophy finding (gates the marked-rotation add).

special_consideration.description: Optional: a special consideration label exactly as the engine lists it for this body part (an invalid label returns the allowed list).
